findings.what: A 2xx answer whose body isn't JSON returns kind 'ok' with value undefined cast to Policy. sellPolicy and getPolicy then throw on answer.value.reference, and the Sell button stays busy.
findings.why: The I4 fix catches the parse error but makes the 'ok' branch lie about its type. remember() dereferences .reference (lines 288 and 294), so the promise rejects. SellPolicy.send never resets inFlight, and PolicyView stays on 'waiting for the API'. BUSY-1 says 'When the process ends, the control re-enables and the result or problem appears.' WB-3 renders the answer the API gave. The configured proxy makes this unlikely, but the type should not claim a Policy it doesn't hold.

findings.what: Only the error summary's and the problem banner's chip hrefs are asserted. The send-anyway list's chips and the timeline's ruleApplied chip get ruleHref, but no test checks their href.
findings.why: RuleLinks.ts used to rewrite every chip in the document. Now that it's gone, each composite has to receive ruleHref (gate.green 00:17:23Z lists SendAnywayToggle and TermTimeline). If SendAnywayToggle (SellPolicy.tsx:393) or TermTimeline (PolicyView.tsx:86) lost the prop, those chips would fall back to '/rules/<id>', which isn't a route in the hash app, and every W1 test would still pass. WB-3: 'each violation as a rule chip that links to RULE-1 for that rule'.

findings.what: The rule-page link '#/rules/' + ruleId is written four times: ProblemView.tsx:4, PolicyView.tsx:86 and SellPolicy.tsx:251 and :393.
findings.why: code-quality, rule of three: extract on the third occurrence when the copies change for the same reason. All four change if RULE-1's route changes. ProblemView already has a ruleHref const that it doesn't export.

findings.what: .s-wb-list isn't used by any file under src/web/app since Renew, QuoteCancel and RecordClaim were deleted.
findings.why: code-quality slop list: dead code. 99b3e57 removed the three unbuilt screens (inv-006 recommendation 1), and their layout class stayed behind.
